Stop the 6-month advance payment for TV licences, We need to Government to abolish the 6 months credit from TV licence direct debit payments. Knight SUFC manager Chris Wilder given his recent record breaking achievement, Open for discussion the potential knighthood of Sheffield United manager Chris Wilder for his services to Sheffield United Football Club., Chris Wilder should be recognised for his exceptional service to Sheffield United FC. Seek international pact for immediate border closures upon discovery of epidemic, The UK Government should seek a global agreement so that ALL countries agree to IMMMEDIATELY stop travel in and out of their country if they discover an epidemic - no matter the economic cost. Open gyms during national lockdowns., Allow gyms to reopen during the national lockdown to allow people to escape and help maintain good mental and physical health., It is medically proven that regular physical activity helps improve your overall health, fitness, and quality of life. Fund a PC laptop for remote learning for every child/student, The Government should fund all schools & colleges to provide 1 PC laptop to EVERY student registered to allow remote working., Government has put into place restrictions which require children/students to learn from home, but with ZERO steps taken to make this possible. End extreme government activity in COVID-19, At what point in time did the government take control over how we live our daily lives. Give Psychiatric Assistance Dogs the same rights as other Assistance Dogs, The Government should alter the law to allow Psychiatric Assistance Dogs to have the same rights as other assistance dogs. Grant an urgent Amnesty to Undocumented Migrants living in the UK, Undocumented Migrants are suffering  in silence, with no access to adequate Financial support, or any help. Review and increase expense rates for employees travelling outside the UK, HMRC sets scale rate expenses for accommodation and subsistence paid to employees who travel outside of the UK, such as cabin crew. There are reports from schools about problems in classrooms, due to vaping: eg. reduced concentration and poor behaviour. Serious side effects may include: Severe lung injury, Seizures, Bronchiolitis obliterans, organizing pneumonia, Popcorn lung, Strokes, Heart attacks

Reinstate Capital Punishment, for crimes against children, Hold a Referendum on bringing back the death penalty for crimes against children, as there would be a huge majority of the population in favour.,

Hold a referendum to reinstate capital punishment for child murder, There were 68 child murders in the year ending March 2019 and 45 child murders in the year ending March 2020.  The people should have the right to decide whether capital punishment should be applied for these heinous crimes., Many child murderers are now free, walking our streets.  Our children should and must be protected.  The law has a duty to protect the innocent.

Open case on child grooming gangs in hull, I would like discussions in parliament as to why the case of child grooming gangs in Hull was dismissed despite victims coming forward and overwhelming evidence, Over the last week it has been well publicised a gang around Hull have been grooming young girls and threatening them with violence if they don't cooperate.
I am hoping to start this petition  to get this discussed in parliament to reopen this case and hopefully bring these people to justice for these dreadful crimes and stop these gangs  from repeating these treacherous crimes on our children or grandchildren and get some justice for the poor girls who have been let down by our justice system

Bring back death penalty for child killers and mass murderers, Bring back capital punishment for people who are convicted of murdering a child, and for people who are convicted of murdering more than person., Harsher punishments are needed - for the worst of crimes, this should mean death.

Introduce a fact check procedure in the parliamentary process, Parliamentary privilege means that our politicians can say what they want in parliament. They can lie with impunity, the only challenges to the truth can come from the opposition, or interventions from the speaker. I want Hansard to include fact checking in its records within 24hr of a debate, The electorate need to have faith in its politicians. There is anecdotal evidence of some MP’s purposely telling mistruths in parliament. There have also been cases where some MP’s have called out these mistruths only to be reprimanded by the speaker. We need truth. We need honesty. We do not need blatant lies recorded in Hansard. In the 21st century it should be possible to fact check debate and make a comment in the records that a lie has been told.

Require medical professionals to report suspected vaccine side effects/injuries, The Government should make it a legal requirement for medical professionals to report any suspected vaccine side effects or injuries, to ensure data on reported side effects and injuries is as comprehensive as possible., Many people lack confidence in the NHS and the Government, and creating this new requirement could help restore confidence.

Make mental health crisis support available through 999, I work answering 999 calls and an extremely high number of callers need immediate support from the mental health service. There is no mental health crisis team available on 999. This means support is delayed because they are dealt with by police or ambulance then passed over to crisis teams., There are far too many people experiencing crisis as a result of mental health issues calling 999, where the support they need is not immediately available.
 
This takes resources away from others needing ambulance and police, while people needing mental health support do not receive the assistance they need as quickly as possible.
 
Adding mental health crisis services to the 999 service should take pressure of police and ambulance, and better serve people experiencing mental health crises.

Calls upon all elected MPs to honestly reflect whether PM is fit for office., Honesty and integrity should be prerequisites for becoming An MP; the current PM  demonstrably lacks candour and integrity and now hinders the Government ability to lead at a time of crisis., As a Public health consultant and GP I have given my all for this country; Sing that our prime minister can out with such disregard for everybody else other than himself and those of his set, and I think it is beyond unfair.

Do not close gyms and fitness facilities if there is another lockdown, We would like to ask Parliament to seriously consider ensuring that gyms and health and fitness facilities are classed as essential and that they will not be forced to close if a lockdown is implemented in response to the omicron variant., Gyms and health and fitness facilities provide a huge public service in enabling people to be physically and mentally better. We have been told that health is a priority by this Government yet gyms consistently get shut down when a lockdown is called.
 
We would like the Government to class gyms as essential services so they can be part of the solution against Covid. It's well known that if we increase exercise, it improves our immune systems so we are better able to fight viruses.

Restore confidence in the social security overpayment recovery waiver system, Overpayment recovery information evidences that by monetary value, only 0.006% of Universal Credit Official Error (DWP mistake) overpayments were written off (waivered) by DWP using the guidance contained within the benefit overpayment recovery guide (Chapter 8 – Write-off and waivers)., The benefit overpayment recovery guide (Chapter 8 – Write-off and waivers) outlines the circumstances where the Secretary of State has the discretion to waive recovery of an overpayment and any associated penalty including: "where recovery is detrimental to the health or welfare of the debtor or a member of their family".

Given the miniscule number of overpayments which are waivered (written off), the Secretary of State needs to restore confidence in overpayment recovery waiver system.

Reinstate the 14 years rule for entitlement to indefinite leave to remain, Too many migrants are the victim of hostile immigration policy. We believe current rules applying to migrants who entered the country lawfully but then overstayed are inhumane and unjustified. These migrants should be entitled to indefinite leave to remain after living here for 14 years., Bringing back the 14 years rule for overstayers who entered legitimately with visa could help reduce modern slavery and also encourage migrants to come legally and not pursue dangerous and illegal routes into the UK.

Legalise assisted dying for terminally ill, mentally competent adults, The Government should bring forward legislation to allow assisted dying for adults who are terminally ill and have mental capacity. It should be permitted subject to strict upfront safeguards, assessed by two doctors independently, and self-administered by the dying person., Dying people in the UK should not have to suffer unbearably against their wishes in their final days and weeks of life. Without assisted dying, some people will die without adequate pain relief, symptom control or dignity. People should not be forced to take drastic measures or travel to another country to end their own life; they should have the option of dying at home, on their own terms, just as dying people do in New Zealand and parts of Australia and the USA, as well as several countries in Europe.

Allow those with 5 years ICT visa to apply for ILR, The Government should allow those who have been on Intra-company transfer (ICT) visas for five years to apply for Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR). Currently time on an ICT does not count towards eligibility for ILR., The ICT route should be a route to settlement, without the need to switch to other routes to obtain settlement. Time spent on the ICT visa should also count towards settlement, ICT migrants complement the UK labour force bringing in expertise and knowledge that can be transferred to UK workers
